verdict.rationale: Gecko's docs show that each finding includes a suggested patch. Developers can click Request fix to open a gecko/* pull request with the patch applied, or apply it themselves. For PR scans, Gecko can commit the fix directly to the PR's head branch, offers one-click fixes on pull requests, and rechecks findings to mark them Fix verified. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the generated patches are correct and work in practice (community reports discuss detection accuracy, not fixes).

support.subject: As a developer, I can apply suggested or automatic code fixes for findings instead of only reading reports
